items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the internal frost-fractured valve: 1 × €52.
Section 7.1.9 covers the connection hose renewed with the fractured valve: 1 × €27.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover the billed repair labour: 3 hours at about €100 per hour.

Sections 7.1.7(e) and 3.6(c) distinguish consumables actually used in the repair from contractor supplies. This generic line was not paid in the matching references; if substantiated as repair consumables, the estimate is €10 for the one billed unit.
Section 7.1.11 covers one attendance. No monetary reduction is stated, so the full-cover benchmark is about €83 for the one billed visit.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging used to locate the internal escape. One use is estimated at €17.60, below the €2,500 gross event cap.

items.description: Facade damage from internal water escape
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 covers render damaged when internally escaped water froze in the wall; no optional frost cover is needed. The single facade line is estimated at €165 if it prices distinct repair work rather than duplicating the itemised work below.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(a) cover removal of failed plaster in the affected area. One removal item is estimated at €90, provided it is not already included in line 7.
Section 7.1.7(c)–(d) covers like-for-like base plaster on the affected facade: 1 × €38.
Section 9.6 requires the work to be identifiable and allocable to the insured damage. If itemised and shown to be necessary, the single allowance is estimated at €80.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers re-forming the substrate in the area damaged by escaped water: 1 × €31.
Section 7.1.7(d) covers the coats required by the matching finish system on the affected area. The four coats are priced as one billed item at €59.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers necessary drying of the wall saturated by the insured escape before reinstatement: 1 × €254.
Section 7.1.7(c)–(d) covers priming the affected substrate for the replacement finish: 1 × €117.
Section 7.1.7(f) covers labour to restore the affected finish. All 5 billed hours are valued at about €55.40 per hour.

Sections 7.1.12 and 9.6 require an identifiable body of covered work; a flat rate with no stated scope does not qualify as billed. If shown to price distinct covered work, the single charge is estimated at €45.
